mentions.description: A local proxy manager that connects servers and exposes a single URL externally. It was initially built to work with MCP servers, enabling OAuth to work locally through a UI -> backend -> MCP client flow, and gains new features over time.

mentions.name: connectio
mentions.description: This app runs a local proxy server that takes configurable rules and lets users add applications, exposing the server's address on the network so everything can be accessed from there. It is a work in progress with further improvements planned.
mentions.problem: While building an MCP application at the author's organization, code changes had to be made to match AWS load balancer requirements; this proxy app aims to handle that with rules instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a local proxy application locally. I was building a mcp application in my organization and had to make some code changes to match what we wanted on the AWS load balancer. So I thought why not have an application that runs a server, takes some rules and allows users to add applications.
